QuestInfo.name: Asking After Jake, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p417##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p417# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p417#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I wonder how #p417#, one of the residents of #m10003000#, is doing. It's absolutely NOT because I'm curious if #p417# is still scared of #o17#! Anyway, it'd be great if you could go check on them for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: So... oh, right! You're #h0#, aren't you? So many people pass through here that I got confused for a second. Haha. As you can see, the subway is completely crawling with monsters today too.
1.1: Personally, I find #o17# really terrifying. Just looking at them makes me imagine awful things. But you know, I can't help but feel like the city is hiding something from me. Otherwise, there's no way they would just leave a dangerous subway like this completely abandoned, right? I wonder what they're up to...
1.2: Haha! Listen to me go on. Anyway, it's the job I've been given, so I just need to work hard every day. Well, let's both do our best today!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
